notes:
CRM notes: evaluation focused on Hosted -> Dedicated path. Product leads (CTO + Head of ML) ran demo 2026-02-18; liked latency but concerned about long-term unit cost.

Key quote from CTO: 'We need predictable unit economics per active user — can't have a bill that spikes unpredictably.'

Requirements summary: wanting chat + embeddings for support agent and knowledge search. Target latency: p95 <= 200ms for short-turn chat (customer intent flows), throughput target ~150–250 RPS during peak (estimated 600k tokens/day). Cost sensitivity: looking to hit <$X0.003 per 1k tokens equivalent across production workloads; open to model trade-offs.

Security/compliance: Okta SSO (SAML), SOC2 required, audit logs for one year, KMS for key separation, data residency: US + EU partitioning.

Preferred rollout: start on Hosted API for quick integration and monitoring, then lift to Dedicated when committed throughput/pricing confirmed. Interested in Optimize toolkit to drive batching/caching recommendations and quantization guidance.

From AE (Maya): "We positioned Hosted as low-effort onramp; they asked for a 6-week Dedicated POC with real traffic replay and cost analysis. They want a hands-on workshop to tune batching/caching and quantify savings from int8/4-bit quantization profiles."

POC success metrics: 1) stable p95 latency under 200ms, 2) end-to-end cost per monthly active user <= target range, 3) reproducible batch sizing strategy that doesn't degrade UX, 4) security checklist passed (SAML, audit logs, KMS).
